text: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy,
For I rejoiced greatly, when brothers came and testified
I have no greater joy than this, to hear about my children
Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish
They have testified about your love before the assembly.
because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing
We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow
I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first
Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds
Beloved, don't imitate that which is evil, but that which is good.
Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself;
I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write
but I hope to see you soon, and we will speak face to face.
